name: Treaty with the Potawatomi, April 22, 1836 (bands of Nas-waw-kee and Quash-quaw)
aka: Treaty of the Indian Agency, Indiana, with Nas-waw-kee and Quash-quaw
nations: Potawatomi bands of Nas-waw-kee and Quash-quaw, Indiana
promises: Article 1: the bands ceded three sections reserved for them by Article 2 of the Tippecanoe treaty of October 26, 1832.
Article 2: $1,920 at the first annuity payment after ratification.
Article 3: the bands would give possession and remove within two years to the country west of the Mississippi provided for the Potawatomi nation.
Article 5: the United States would pay the expenses of making the treaty.
today: No court, Indian Claims Commission or government finding about this band cession was found. The Commission's Potawatomi decisions that were opened (Dockets 15-P, 29-N and 306 on the 1832 Tippecanoe cession; Docket 128 et al. on other Indiana and Michigan cessions; Docket 15-D et al.) value Royce areas 98, 110, 132, 133, 145, 146, 177, 180 and 181 and do not mention this band reserve.

openQuestions: treaties.json error: the record's Kappler link (seq 466, p. 458) is the other treaty of April 22, 1836, with O-kah-mause, Kee-waw-nay, Nee-boash and Mat-chis-jaw (10 sections, $6,400, 7 Stat. 500). Its scheduleTribes and Royce area 210 are the bands of Nas-waw-kee and Quash-quaw, whose treaty is on p. 459 (7 Stat. 501). This file follows the area and schedule name and researches 7 Stat. 501. Royce schedules the O-kah-mause treaty as its own entry; whether it has a record in treaties.json was not found.
Whether the $1,920 was paid was not traced; Article 4 was stricken by the Senate.

Whether the Indian Claims Commission or the Court of Claims ever valued the small 1834 to 1837 band reserve cessions in Indiana was not found; the Potawatomi of Indiana and Michigan dockets (29-K and related) and the Commission's 1978 Final Report docket list should be checked.

The Forest County Potawatomi list the 1834 and 1836 band treaties on their treaty pages but give no account of them; which present-day nations descend from this band was not confirmed (treaties.json names the Citizen Potawatomi Nation).
